fields.description: First part of every file number, e.g. HEA in HEA/101/1/1.
fields.label: File Number Prefix

fields.description: Code allocated to the Authority. Domestic subjects are numbered under it (101/1, 101/2 ...).
fields.label: Domestic Subject Code

fields.description: One per line. A file title containing any of these is refused, as the file index requires.
fields.label: Words Not Allowed in File Titles

fields.description: Naming series for each register. .YYYY. is the year and .##### the running number, e.g. HEA/IN/.YYYY./.##### gives HEA/IN/2026/00001. The number restarts when the part before the hashes changes.
fields.label: Correspondence Reference Numbers

fields.description: Scans attached to correspondence are filed in Drive, in a folder per registry file (named by file number, with - for /) under the folder below. Leave the team empty to keep scans as ordinary attachments.
fields.label: Drive

fields.description: Who receives items for each department, and who overdue items go to. Due dates come from each urgency's Days to Respond; reminders are set in the Notification list.
fields.label: Routing and Deadlines

fields.description: Overdue items go first to the Departmental Head, then to these people.
fields.label: Escalate Overdue Items to Management

fields.description: How many days after the Departmental Head is told an item is overdue it goes to Management.
fields.label: Days Overdue Before Management
